subject: FedRAMP-Lite privacy annex + DPIA evidence request — UW System RFP
messages:
From: Diane Porter <diane.porter@uws.edu>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: uws-procurement@uws.edu, Mark Benton <mark.benton@statecontracts.gov>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: FedRAMP-Lite privacy annex + DPIA evidence for UW System RFP

Hi Olga,

Thanks for taking my call this morning. As part of the UW System cloud services RFP (section 4.2.3), the evaluation team needs a FedRAMP-Lite-style privacy annex and supporting DPIA evidence so we can complete our privacy impact review. Specifically they asked for: 

- A short privacy annex that maps to UWS DPA requirements and SCCs expectations
- A DPIA summary that explains data flows for student records (pseudonymization, retention, access controls)
- SOC 2 evidence / bridge that shows controls for data access, logging, and incident response
- Answers to a handful of CAIQ/ SIG Lite questions around encryption-in-transit and at-rest

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide a draft privacy annex and the DPIA summary this quarter? The committee would prefer a deliverable by Oct 9 so we can circulate before their Oct 16 scoring meeting.

If helpful, I can share our RFP excerpt (attachment) and the DPIA template the university uses.

Thanks,
Diane Porter
Procurement Lead — UW System Contracts
Diane.Porter@uws.edu
(206) 555-0148

Attachment: UWS_RFP_Section4.2.3.pdf (attachment stub)

From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
To: Diane Porter <diane.porter@uws.edu>
Cc: uws-procurement@uws.edu
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: FedRAMP-Lite privacy annex + DPIA evidence for UW System RFP

Diane — thanks for the clear ask and the call earlier. Redwood can support this request. High-level reply and proposed timeline below.

What we can deliver (drafts):
- FedRAMP-Lite privacy annex tailored to UWS wording and SCCs mapping (docx)
- DPIA summary (1–2 pages) with data flow diagram stub and controls mapping (pdf)
- SOC 2 bridge matrix showing control mapping and most recent report references (xlsx)
- CAIQ/SIG-lite answers (spreadsheet / Q&A)

Proposed timeline:
- 10/04: Redwood sends DPIA summary + SOC2 bridge + annex skeleton for review (internal review complete)
- 10/07: UW provides feedback / redlines
- 10/09: Deliver updated annex and final attachments for UW scoring committee

Two quick clarifying questions from our side: 1) Is the scope limited to student PII and contractor access, or do you want enterprise telemetry logs included? 2) Do you require a signed amendment / annex via DocuSign or a draft for procurement review is sufficient initially?

I'll loop in our compliance and product ops folks to pull the artifacts.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Sr. Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0199

From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 13:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: UWS privacy annex — small artifact push (internal)

Team — Diane at UW System asked for a FedRAMP-Lite privacy annex + DPIA summary for an RFP. Committed timeline asks for initial artifacts by EOD 10/04.

Can you triage the following:
- Jonas: pull DPIA summary draft and a minimal data flow diagram we can include (student records scope). See attached UW template (from Diane).
- Marissa: prepare SOC2 bridge matrix (control IDs -> evidence locations) and a CAIQ/SIG-lite worksheet with the encryption + logging answers.

I attached the RFP excerpt Diane sent. We'll need the annex in docx form and a PDF for distribution.

Thanks —
Olga

Attachment: UWS_RFP_Section4.2.3.pdf (forwarded message)

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: UWS privacy annex — DPIA + artifacts (internal)

Olga / Marissa — quick status update:

- redwood_dpia_summary_v1.pdf attached: 1.5 pages, includes data flow for student PII, retention windows, pseudonymization notes, and mapping to UWS DPIA template sections.
- fedramp-lite-privacy-annex_draft.docx attached: skeleton with SCCs references and UW-specific clauses where we may need legal sign-off.
- SOC2-bridge-2026.xlsx attached: control mapping (AICPA vs. Redwood evidence location), not yet fully annotated for runbook links.

Open items: 
- Legal needs to confirm the UW-specific clause on data export and subprocessors (I can flag the clause).
- Product ops to validate retention windows for telemetry logs if they want them included.

I'll attach the three files now to the outbound to Diane once we have sign-off from Marissa on the SOC2 mapping.

Thanks,
Jonas
Compliance Analyst — Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
